context_exchanges.label: Messages remembered in a chat
context_exchanges.hint: How many recent back-and-forth messages Aldwin rereads before it answers. More helps it keep track of a long chat but makes each answer slower and costlier.

max_steps.label: Steps per answer
max_steps.hint: The most actions (searching, reading a file, using an app) Aldwin takes for one message before it stops and reports back.

web_searches.label: Web searches per answer
web_searches.hint: The most times Aldwin searches the web for one message, so a single question can't use up your search engine's allowance.

connector_tools.label: App tools offered at once
connector_tools.hint: The most tools from your connected apps Aldwin can see at one time. Too many can confuse the model.

profile_chars.label: About you: length read
profile_chars.hint: How much of your profile, the notes about you from setup, Aldwin reads, in characters.

notes_chars.label: Recent notes: length read
notes_chars.hint: How much of the notes Aldwin keeps between chats it reads, in characters.

notes_days.label: Recent notes: days
notes_days.hint: How many days back of those notes Aldwin reads.

persona_chars.label: Personality: length read
persona_chars.hint: How much of Aldwin's personality and answer style it reads, in characters.

updatesHint: When Aldwin starts, it asks PyPI, where Aldwin is published, for the latest version number and tells you if there is a newer one.
